title: Zoolander
description: A dim male model's career starts to decline and he fails to realise he is a pawn in a dangerous game of international espionage. Comedy, starring Ben Stiller and Owen Wilson.

title: Zoolander 2
description: A dim-witted supermodel must step back into the spotlight when a maniac starts murdering some of the world's most beautiful pop stars. Comedy sequel, starring Ben Stiller.

title: Team America: World Police
description: A global counter-terrorism squad travels around the world creating as much destruction as its intended targets. Puppet comedy, with the voices of Trey Parker and Matt Stone.

title: American Pie 2
description: The teenage friends get together after their first year at college and set out to broaden their sexual horizons over the summer. Comedy sequel, with Jason Biggs and Chris Klein.

title: The Phoenician Scheme
description: A rich businessman and his daughter become the target of scheming tycoons, terrorists and assassins. Wes Anderson's comedy, starring Benicio del Toro.

title: Superbad
description: Two teenagers hope to lose their virginity at a party - but to get into the bash they must take booze, which proves harder than expected. Comedy, with Jonah Hill and Michael Cera.

title: Bridesmaids
description: A disorganised woman takes charge of her best friend's bridal party, but the wife of the groom's boss causes problems. Comedy, with Kristen Wiig, Rose Byrne and Melissa McCarthy.

title: American Pie: The Wedding
description: The friends reunite to celebrate Jim and Michelle's forthcoming trip to the altar - but events quickly spiral out of control. Comedy sequel, with Jason Biggs and Alyson Hannigan.

title: Instant Family
description: A couple decide to adopt, but get more than they bargained for when they take in a rebellious teen and her two siblings. Comedy, starring Mark Wahlberg and Rose Byrne.

title: We're the Millers
description: A drug dealer recruits a fake family to give him a cover for moving a shipment of marijuana over the Mexican border. Comedy, with Jason Sudeikis and Jennifer Aniston.

title: Logan Lucky
description: Two brothers attempt to pull off a heist during a Nascar race in North Carolina. Crime caper, starring Channing Tatum and Adam Driver.

title: One of Them Days
description: Two roommates race against time to avoid eviction after a boyfriend spends their rent money. Comedy, starring Keke Palmer and SZA.

title: Team America: World Police
description: A global counter-terrorism squad travels around the world creating as much destruction as its intended targets. Puppet comedy, with the voices of Trey Parker and Matt Stone.

title: About Last Night
description: Danny and Debbie pursue a relationship after a one-night stand, despite the warnings of their cynical friends. Romantic comedy remake, with Michael Ealy and Joy Bryant.

title: Yesterday
description: A musician wakes up after being hit by a bus to find he is the only person in the world who remembers the Beatles. Comedy, with Himesh Patel and Lily James. Directed by Danny Boyle.

title: American Pie: The Wedding
description: The friends reunite to celebrate Jim and Michelle's forthcoming trip to the altar - but events quickly spiral out of control. Comedy sequel, with Jason Biggs and Alyson Hannigan.

title: Little Fockers
description: A father of twins invites his family to his kids' birthday party and tries to finally prove his worth to his father-in-law. Comedy sequel, with Ben Stiller and Robert De Niro.

title: White Chicks
description: Two black male FBI agents are forced to pose as white female debutantes to protect a couple of heiresses from a kidnapping plot. Comedy, starring brothers Shawn and Marlon Wayans.

title: Bridget Jones: Mad About the Boy
description: Recently widowed Bridget enters the dating game again, caught between her son's science teacher and a younger man. Romantic comedy, starring Renee Zellweger.

title: The Wedding Singer
description: A waitress catches the eye of a failed rock star performing at a wedding reception and helps him turn his life around. Romantic comedy, starring Adam Sandler and Drew Barrymore.

title: American Reunion
description: Old friends attending a high-school reunion make disastrous attempts to relive their teens. Comedy sequel to the American Pie movies, with Jason Biggs and Alyson Hannigan.

title: The Naked Gun
description: Following in the footsteps of his legendary father, Frank Drebin Jr must save his police department by solving a case. Comedy reboot, starring Liam Neeson.

title: Paul
description: A captive alien escapes from a secret military base and seeks the help of two English comic-book geeks in getting to his spaceship. Sci-fi comedy, with Simon Pegg and Nick Frost.
